title: Hungary Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Hungary study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Hungary study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: University offer / admission letter from a recognized Hungarian institution; Proof of funds covering tuition + living for the required period; Passport, photos, completed visa forms; Academic transcripts and certificates (attestation/translation when asked). SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Hungary from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Hungary is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Hungary study visa?
faqs.answer: Many Hungarian programmes accept IELTS, MOI letters or internal English tests. Confirm the exact 2026 intake rule for your university — UK-style SELT is not always required.

faqs.question: Can I study in Hungary with low marks?
faqs.answer: Hungary is frequently explored for ~50–65% profiles when the rest of the file is strong. Embassies still decide; low marks alone do not guarantee admission or visa.

faqs.question: How long does Hungary student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 3–6 months from shortlist to visa decision, longer in peak intakes.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Hungary student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport and biometric photos; Admission / offer letter; Academic certificates and mark sheets; Bank statements / sponsor affidavit as required; SOP / motivation letter and CV; Insurance and fee receipts; Accommodation proof when requested.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Hungary?
faqs.answer: Limited part-time work may be allowed under student residence rules — exact hours change; verify before relying on work income for funds.

faqs.question: How to apply for Hungary study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Hungary study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Hungary student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

body:
Why students from Pakistan look at Hungary

Popular for medicine-related pathways, business, IT and foundation routes. Many universities accept moderate marks when documents and funds are clean. Living costs are usually lower than Western Europe.

Schengen / EU

Requirements

  • University offer / admission letter from a recognized Hungarian institution
  • Proof of funds covering tuition + living for the required period
  • Passport, photos, completed visa forms
  • Academic transcripts and certificates (attestation/translation when asked)
  • Health insurance meeting embassy rules
  • Language evidence (IELTS, MOI, or university test — depends on programme)

Process — how to apply from Pakistan

  1. Profile review — marks, budget, field of study
  2. University shortlist and application support
  3. Admission + tuition/deposit planning
  4. Document packaging and VFS/consular appointment
  5. Biometrics and decision tracking

Documents checklist

  • Passport and biometric photos
  • Admission / offer letter
  • Academic certificates and mark sheets
  • Bank statements / sponsor affidavit as required
  • SOP / motivation letter and CV
  • Insurance and fee receipts
  • Accommodation proof when requested

Interactive checklist: Open Hungary checklist →

Fees

Embassy/VFS fees + tuition deposit + living proof; SK Immigration student packages from PKR 50,000.

Timeline

Often 3–6 months from shortlist to visa decision, longer in peak intakes.

IELTS / English

Many Hungarian programmes accept IELTS, MOI letters or internal English tests. Confirm the exact 2026 intake rule for your university — UK-style SELT is not always required.

Low marks & gaps

Hungary is frequently explored for ~50–65% profiles when the rest of the file is strong. Embassies still decide; low marks alone do not guarantee admission or visa.

Work while studying

Limited part-time work may be allowed under student residence rules — exact hours change; verify before relying on work income for funds.

Common mistakes

  • Choosing a programme that does not match prior academics
  • Weak or unexplained funds
  • Assuming MOI is accepted without checking the university
  • Booking appointment before documents are ready
  • Paying agents who promise “100% Hungary visa”

Related

Deeper guide: Hungary student visa guide.

Why Pakistani students shortlist Hungary

Hungary is often compared with Poland and Czech Republic for English-taught programmes and a Schengen long-stay student process that can fit mid-range budgets — when the university is real, fees are paid to the school (not only an agent), and funds are explainable.

TopicWhat to check before you pay
University recognitionProgram appears on the university site; fee letter matches; avoid broker-only PDFs
IELTS / MOIConfirm the written language rule on the offer (IELTS, university test, or MOI)
FundsTuition + living for the period the mission asks; sponsor trail must be clear
AttestationHEC / MOFA / legalization order for your document type
AppointmentComplete file first — VFS Hungary Pakistan queues reward preparation

Hungary vs Poland vs Czech (planning compare)

  • Hungary: Strong interest in medicine-related and English degrees; watch recognition and deposits
  • Poland: Broad English-program market; purpose + funds still decide visas
  • Czech Republic: Language and recognition planning matter; not automatically “easier”

Read Hungary vs Poland · Official Hungary links · Study in Hungary.

Mistakes we see on Hungary files

  • Large deposits to unverified agents before confirming the university
  • Assuming “no IELTS” without written university acceptance of MOI
  • One-month bank spikes that cannot be explained
  • SOPs that never mention Hungary or the faculty
  • Confusing a short Schengen visit with a long-stay student residence
